```csharp
using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendCheckpointAsync_LogsCheckpointSearchCompleted()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<dynamic>();
            var mockCurrentConfig = new Mock<dynamic>();

            string replicaNodeId = "replica1";

            // Setup clusterProvider and clusterManager to return a valid address and port
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);
            mockClusterManager.Setup(cm => cm.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockCurrentConfig.Object);
            mockCurrentConfig.Setup(cc => cc.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(replicaNodeId)).Returns(("127.0.0.1", 12345));

            // Setup other dependencies minimally to allow SendCheckpointAsync to run
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(It.IsAny<StoreType>())).Returns((object)null);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.replicationManager).Returns(new Mock<dynamic>().Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.serverOptions).Returns(new Mock<dynamic>().Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.ClusterUsername).Returns("user");
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.ClusterPassword).Returns("pass");

            var replicaCheckpointEntry = new CheckpointEntry
            {
                metadata = new Metadata
                {
                    storeVersion = 1,
                    objectStoreVersion = 1,
                    storePrimaryReplId = "primary1",
                    objectStorePrimaryReplId = "primary1",
                    storeHlogToken = default,
                    storeIndexToken = default,
                    objectStoreHlogToken = default,
                    objectStoreIndexToken = default
                }
            };

            var session = new ReplicaSyncSession(
                storeWrapper: new Mock<StoreWrapper>().Object,
                clusterProvider: mockClusterProvider.Object,
                replicaSyncMetadata: null,
                token: CancellationToken.None,
                replicaNodeId: replicaNodeId,
                replicaAssignedPrimaryId: null,
                replicaCheckpointEntry: replicaCheckpointEntry,
                replicaAofBeginAddress: 0,
                replicaAofTailAddress: 0,
                logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // We need to mock AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync to return a valid tuple
            // But since we cannot override it, we will skip that and just test the logging call by invoking SendCheckpointAsync and catching exceptions

            // Act
            try
            {
                await session.SendCheckpointAsync();
            }
            catch
            {
                // Ignore exceptions, we only want to verify logging
            }

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Checkpoint search completed")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }

    // Minimal stubs for types used in the test
    public class CheckpointEntry
    {
        public Metadata metadata { get; set; }
    }

    public class Metadata
    {
        public int storeVersion { get; set; }
        public int objectStoreVersion { get; set; }
        public string storePrimaryReplId { get; set; }
        public string objectStorePrimaryReplId { get; set; }
        public object storeHlogToken { get; set; }
        public object storeIndexToken { get; set; }
        public object objectStoreHlogToken { get; set; }
        public object objectStoreIndexToken { get; set; }
    }

    public enum StoreType
    {
        Main,
        Object
    }

    public class StoreWrapper { }
}
```
